tasks.label: Quality Check: All Domains
tasks.command: Write-Host '=== COMPLETE QUALITY CHECK ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $domains = @('Abstract','Field','Form','Links','Table'); $totalFailed = 0; foreach ($domain in $domains) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ("{0} Domain:" -f $domain) -ForegroundColor Yellow; if ($domain -eq 'Abstract') { $path = 'c:\_src\app-mvplounge-meshfactory\src\MvpLounge\MeshFactory\Abstract' } else { $path = Join-Path 'c:\_src\app-mvplounge-meshfactory\src\MvpLounge\MeshFactory\Element' $domain }; if (Test-Path $path) { $failed = 0; Get-ChildItem $path -Filter '*.php' | ForEach-Object { $lintResult = & 'C:/xampp_devops_test/php/php.exe' -l $_.FullName 2>&1; if ($lintResult -notmatch 'No syntax errors') { Write-Host ("  ✗ {0}" -f $_.Name); $failed++; $totalFailed++ } else { Write-Host ("  ✓ {0}" -f $_.Name) } }; $count = (Get-ChildItem $path -Filter '*.php').Count; Write-Host ("  Result: {0} files, {1} failed" -f $count, $failed) } }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== FINAL RESULT ===' -ForegroundColor $(if ($totalFailed -gt 0) { 'Red' } else { 'Green' }); Write-Host ("Total Failed: {0}" -f $totalFailed) -ForegroundColor $(if ($totalFailed -gt 0) { 'Red' } else { 'Green' })

# Architecture Clarification Report

## Input Summary
$question

## Architecture Fit Assessment
- Does this align with current architecture layers and naming contracts?

## Push-Back and Risk Review
- Compatibility:
- Style consistency:
- Performance:
- Security:
- Functional correctness:
- Efficiency and maintainability:

## Hybrid Recommendation

- Experimental option:
- Recommended hybrid path:

## Terminology and Documentation Linkage

## Implementation Decision

"@ | Set-Content -Path $outFile -Encoding utf8; Write-Host "Created Architecture Clarification report: $outFile" -ForegroundColor Green
